title: Practical SME Bookkeeping & Cloud Accounting
description: Manage day-to-day bookkeeping, reconcile bank statements, and configure cloud accounting software for SMEs. Tests double-entry principles, software setup, and financial reporting.

seo.overviewTitle: SME Bookkeeping & Cloud Accounting (Xero / Sage / QuickBooks)
seo.overviewBody: Cloud accounting platforms streamline financial record-keeping for growing small businesses. Bookkeepers and junior accountants prove value by establishing Chart of Accounts structures, reconciling automated bank feeds, managing invoicing, and producing monthly management accounts.

deliverables.title: 1. Cloud Accounting Setup & Chart of Accounts Spec
deliverables.desc: System setup blueprint establishing general ledger account codes, tax settings, and tracking categories.

deliverables.title: 2. Bank Feed Reconciliation & Trial Balance Export
deliverables.desc: Reconciliation working paper confirming zero unreconciled bank transactions and verified trial balance balances.

deliverables.title: 3. Monthly SME Management Accounts Deck
deliverables.desc: Professional management pack featuring Income Statement, Balance Sheet, Aged Receivables, and Cash Summary.

faqs.question: How should a Chart of Accounts be structured for an SME?
faqs.answer: Organize accounts logically into Assets (1000s), Liabilities (2000s), Equity (3000s), Revenue (4000s), and Expenses (5000s+) with consistent numbering.

faqs.question: What is the difference between Cash-Basis and Accrual-Basis accounting?
faqs.answer: Cash-basis records transactions only when cash moves. Accrual-basis records revenue when earned and expenses when incurred, regardless of cash timing.

faqs.question: How do you handle unreconciled items in bank reconciliations?
faqs.answer: Investigate un-matched transactions against supplier invoices or bank statements, clearing duplicate entries or posting adjusting journal entries.
